from datetime import date
import calendar

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, day_of_month = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Calculate the target month and year
    total_months = year * 12 + month - 1 + n
    target_year = total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1
    
    # Get the last day of the original month
    last_day_of_original_month = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    
    # Get the last day of the target month
    last_day_of_target_month = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
    
    # Apply the billing rule
    if day_of_month == last_day_of_original_month:
        # Original day is last day of its month -> use last day of target month
        target_day = last_day_of_target_month
    else:
        # Keep the same day, but cap at the last day of target month if needed
        target_day = min(day_of_month, last_day_of_target_month)
    
    # Format and return the result
    return f"{target_year:04d}-{target_month:02d}-{target_day:02d}"
